portInfo.description: SeaDays Tenerife maps to the Port Authority of Santa Cruz de Tenerife’s cruise gateway at Muelle Sur. The authority publishes cruise-operations materials specifically for Muelle Sur and a quay inventory showing Tercera Muelle Sur at 805 m / 12 m within Anaga Dock. Other Canary ports under the same authority (La Palma, La Gomera, El Hierro) have separate protocols — out of scope for this slug unless itineraries call there.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Santa Cruz de Tenerife cruise terminal
gettingThere.distanceToCity: Directly in Santa Cruz city center
gettingThere.walkingTime: 5-10 minutes to main shopping areas—confirm on your sailing programme before you rely on a fixed walk time.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Santa Cruz urban core is the nearest option via taxi or bus — confirm fares locally. Teide National Park and southern resort areas need substantial road time; book only on longer calls with confirmed return transport.
gettingThere.distanceAnswer: Directly in Santa Cruz city center

thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Confirm Santa Cruz berth vs any secondary Canary call on multi-island itineraries.
